design_coverage.reason: No fixed-effect term is reported for this baseline fit.
Fama–MacBeth t-statistics divide the time-series average slopes by their time-series standard errors.
No weights are reported for this fit.

implementation_issues.description: I/B/E/S adjustment factors are mandatory for both individual forecasts and actuals, but the local exact-source evidence only identifies a split-factor file and not the stated cumulative split/dividend adjustment product.
The annual [0,1] percentile-rank universe and tie convention are not fixed in the source extraction.
The paper reports annual cross-sectional regressions and Fama–MacBeth time-series standard errors but does not name the underlying estimator for the annual cross-sections.
Individual analyst matching across F−8/F−4/F0, forecast-period selection, stale forecasts, currencies and dollar-volume construction require ordinary data engineering under the stated rules.
The paper’s 1983–2001 observations use historical I/B/E/S, Compustat and CRSP products; current data vintages can revise values and links.

review_notes: Fiscal-year anchors are 1983–2001. Forecast horizons include F−8, F−4 and F0; RET_6/VOL span the six months ending F−4 (earliest F−10). All EPS/revision values and analyst coverage controls use prior-year-end price or prior-year data, so the conservative raw lower bound is 1982. Preserve the 2001 fiscal-period endpoint; actual announcement dates may be later.
Local exact probes verify access/columns only; no local coverage confirmations were supplied for this item. Public EDGAR routes are recorded where relevant, with historical population gaps preserved.
